title: 第二十一章 带人冲刺第二十二章 出来混要讲信用
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;树丛高处，一簇枝林微动。
将顾尘风的目光，掩映在一片昏暗之中。
然而，此刻顾尘风的眼中，却隐有精光浮动。
虽然距离那片战场，仍有不短距离，但顾尘风的耳目何其敏锐。
这些人的对话，又没有刻意隐藏，被他听得一清二楚。
“这些家伙竟然采摘到了冰凝草。”
原本心中就有些想法的顾尘风，越发坚定了一个念头。
“灵草我要，他们得死！”
此番，本就是这伙人对顾尘风下手在先。
从对方的行事风格，和方才的对话可见。
这群人没少干伤天害理之事，都不是好鸟。
所谓除恶便是行善，顾尘风毫无心理负担。
不过，对方毕竟人多势众，有各种阴毒手段，还有一位源气境武者压阵。
他也要寻找，合适的下手时机。
顾尘风静静在树上观察。
此刻，那三当家带着五名通脉境武者，已经出手。
趁着赤焰蛮熊变得虚弱，六名高手携带兵刃，从四面袭杀。
这头赤焰蛮熊的确强悍，即便是通脉境武者的全力攻击，落到它身上。
也最多是划出一道浅浅的血痕，难以造成实质性的伤害。

不过，那三当家的进攻，威力可就不一样了。
顾尘风注意到，三当家手中狼牙棒挥动时。
其双手隐隐泛起淡淡黄芒。
一丝厚重的源气波动，与磅礴气血之力，加持狼牙棒。
轰在赤焰蛮熊身上，发出擂鼓般的闷响。
狼牙棒势大力沉，其上的尖刺，还能刺穿皮肉。
蛮熊吃痛怒吼，伤口不断淌血。
“原来这就是源气境一星武者的实力，倒也……一般。”
顾尘风观察半晌，得出结论，终于决定出手了。
此时，这群人都在围攻赤焰蛮熊，现场一片混乱。
四周不时有个别，听到哨音赶来的四方门武者，加入战场。
“好机会！”
顾尘风目光一亮，身形轻灵如猫，落地无声。
手提长枪，朝前方快速逼近。
顾尘风的衣着普通，与这些四方门武者类似，速度又迅猛，转眼来到战场。
即便有人留意到他，也只当是赶来相助的同门。
而混到人群后方的顾尘风，没有丝毫犹豫。
长枪如电，疾刺而出。
“噗……！”

read2(); High in the trees, a cluster of branches moved slightly.
Gu Chenfeng's eyes were hidden in the darkness.
However, at this moment, there was a glint in Gu Chenfeng's eyes.
Although it was still quite a distance from the battlefield, Gu Chenfeng's ears and eyes were so sharp.
The conversations of these people were not deliberately hidden, and he heard them clearly.
"These guys actually picked the ice grass."
Gu Chenfeng, who originally had some ideas in his mind, became more determined.
"I want the spiritual grass, and they must die!"
This time, it was this group of people who attacked Gu Chenfeng first.
It can be seen from the other party's behavior and the conversation he had just now.
This group of people have done many things that are harmful to nature and are not good birds.
The so-called elimination of evil means doing good, and Gu Chenfeng has no psychological burden.
However, after all, the opponent has a large number of people, has various insidious methods, and has a Source Qi realm warrior to hold the battle.
He also needs to find the right time to strike.
Gu Chenfeng observed quietly on the tree.
At this moment, the third master and five Tongmai realm warriors had taken action.
Taking advantage of the red flame bear becoming weak, six masters carried weapons and attacked from all sides.
This red-flame savage bear is indeed powerful, even if it is attacked by a Tongmai realm warrior with all its strength, it falls on it.
At most, it would only draw a shallow blood mark, and it would be difficult to cause substantial damage.
However, the power of the third master's attack is different.
Gu Chenfeng noticed that the third master was waving the mace in his hand.
His hands glowed with a faint yellow glow.
A trace of thick Origin Qi fluctuations, and the majestic power of Qi and blood, blessed the mace.
It hit the red flame bear and made a muffled sound like a drum.
The mace is powerful and heavy, and the spikes on it can pierce flesh.
The bear roared in pain, its wounds bleeding continuously.
"It turns out that this is the strength of a one-star warrior in the Origin Qi Realm, but it is... average."
Gu Chenfeng observed for a long time, came to a conclusion, and finally decided to take action.
At this time, this group of people were besieging the Red Flame Bear, and the scene was in chaos.
From time to time, there were individual warriors from the Sifang Sect who came after hearing the whistle and joined the battlefield.
"Good opportunity!"
Gu Chenfeng's eyes lit up, his figure was as light as a cat, and he landed silently.
Carrying a long gun, he quickly approached the front.
Gu Chenfeng was dressed in ordinary clothes, similar to these Sifang Sect warriors. He was very fast and arrived at the battlefield in an instant.
Even if someone noticed him, they would just treat him as a fellow disciple who came to help.
But Gu Chenfeng, who had slipped into the back of the crowd, did not hesitate at all.
The spear was like lightning, stabbing out quickly.
"puff……!"
